GOV-F-003-S148.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S148.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema for Brain locks including lock_id, owner_id, TTL timestamp, heartbeat timestamp, and status. Enforce TTL index and validation rules for expiration and ownership fields.

GOV-F-003-S149.title: Lock Acquire/Release API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S149.description: Implement internal API methods for acquiring, renewing (heartbeat), and releasing Brain locks with strict ownership validation and TTL enforcement. Ensure safe concurrent access handling.

GOV-F-003-S150.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S150.description: Integrate lock acquisition, heartbeat refresh, and release into brain_runner execution flow to ensure single-agent execution and prevent concurrent assignment processing conflicts.

GOV-F-003-S151.title: Lock Observability and Audit Logging
GOV-F-003-S151.description: Add structured logging for lock lifecycle events including acquisition, renewal, expiration, recovery, and conflicts. Persist audit records for debugging and operational monitoring.
